5700.meaning1: in-between; in the middle; amidst the conversation
5700.commentary: (VINa) na upajjhāyassa bhaṇamānassa antar'antarā kathā opātetabbā'ti antaraghare vā aññatra vā bhaṇamānassa aniṭṭhite tassa vacane aññā kathā na samuṭṭhāpetabbā. (MNa) antar'antarā kathaṃ opāteyyun'ti mama kathāvāraṃ pacchinditvā antar'antare attano kathaṃ paveseyyun'ti attho.

examples.text: tassa mayhaṃ, bhante, aḍḍakaraṇe nisinnassa antar'antarā kathaṃ opātenti. so'haṃ na labhāmi, mā me bhonto aḍḍakaraṇe nisinnassa antar'antarā kathaṃ opātetha, kathāpariyosānaṃ me bhonto āgamentū'ti.

5702.meaning1: section with elided repetitions; elided repetition series

examples.text: antarapeyyālesu uddānaṃ samattaṃ.

5703.meaning1: governor of a border area; subordinate ruler; (comm) ruler of several villages between two kingdoms

examples.text: rājāno nāma pathabyārājā padesarājā maṇḍalikā antarabhogikā akkhadassā mah'āmattā, ye vā pana chejjabhejjaṃ karontā anusāsanti. ete rājāno nāma.

katamā ca, bhikkhave, sīhaseyyā? sīho, bhikkhave, migarājā dakkhiṇena passena seyyaṃ kappeti, pāde pādaṃ accādhāya, antarasatthimhi naṅguṭṭhaṃ anupakkhipitvā. so paṭibujjhitvā purimaṃ kāyaṃ abbhunnāmetvā pacchimaṃ kāyaṃ anuviloketi.

tej'ussadattā hi sīho migarājā dve purimapāde ekasmiṃ ṭhāne, pacchimapāde ekasmiṃ ṭhāne ṭhapetvā naṅguṭṭhaṃ antarasatthimhi pakkhipitvā purimapāda-pacchimapāda-naṅguṭṭhānaṃ ṭhit'okāsaṃ sallakkhetvā dvinnaṃ purimapādānaṃ matthake sīsaṃ ṭhapetvā sayati.

5707.meaning1: during the rainy season; within the rains retreat

examples.text: atha kho āyasmā puṇṇo ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsakasatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena pañcamattāni upāsikāsatāni paṭivedesi. ten'ev'antaravassena tisso vijjā sacchākāsi. ten'ev'antaravassena parinibbāyi.
ekarattam'pi ce bhikkhu ticīvarena vippavaseyyā'ti saṅghāṭiyā vā uttar'āsaṅgena vā antaravāsakena vā.
tiṇṇaṃ cīvarānaṃ aññataraṃ cīvaran'ti saṅghāṭiṃ vā uttar'āsaṅgaṃ vā antaravāsakaṃ vā.

5709.meaning1: middle of the street; along the road

examples.text: ekadivasaṃ sāyanhasamaye vātapānena antaravīthiṃ olokentī pañca pāsasatāni pañca sūlasatāni ādāya mige vadhitvā jīvamānaṃ ekaṃ kukkuṭamittaṃ nāma nesādaṃ pañca migasatāni vadhitvā tesaṃ maṃsena mahāsakaṭaṃ pūretvā sakaṭadhure nisīditvā maṃsavikkiṇan'atthāya nagaraṃ pavisantaṃ disvā
bhaggesu suṃsumāragire bhesakaḷāvane migadāye antarahito cetīsu pācīnavaṃsadāye āyasmato anuruddhassa sammukhe pāturahosi
seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso sammiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ sammiñjeyya, evam'evaṃ kho, gijjhakūṭe pabbate antarahito sītavane āyasmato soṇassa sammukhe pāturahosi.

5711.grammar: pp of antaradhāyati, in comps, comp vb

examples.text: atha kho, ānanda, antarahito yakkho saddam'anussāvesi, janavasabho ahaṃ bhagavā, janavasabho ahaṃ sugatā'ti. abhijānāsi no tvaṃ, ānanda, ito pubbe evarūpaṃ nāmadheyyaṃ sutaṃ yadidaṃ janavasabho'ti?

5713.meaning1: without any distinction in colour, smell or constituency
5713.commentary: (VISMa) evaṃbhūtassa c'assa yāyaṃ pubbe vaṇṇasampadā, gandhasampadā, abhisaṅkhārasampadā ca, sā ek'aṃsena vinassati, raso pana nasseyya vā na vā'ti āha antarahita-vaṇṇa-gandha-saṅkhāra-viseso'ti.

examples.text: so evaṃ vicuṇṇitamakkhito taṅ'khaṇaññ'eva antarahita-vaṇṇa-gandha-saṅkhāra-viseso suvānadoṇiyaṃ ṭhitasuvānavamathu viya paramajegucchabhāvaṃ upagacchati. evarūpo'pi samāno cakkhussa āpāthaṃ atītattā ajjhoharitabbo hotī'ti evaṃ paribhogato paṭikkūlatā paccavekkhitabbā.

5714.grammar: ind, prep, acc sg of antara (+acc)
5714.meaning1: inside; near to; across; in the vicinity of
5714.commentary: (NIDD1a) na eḷakam'antaran'ti ummāraṃ antaraṃ karitvā diyyamānaṃ na gaṇhāti. kasmā? ayaṃ maṃ nissāya antarakaraṇaṃ labhatī'ti. daṇḍamusalesu'pi es'eva nayo.

examples.text: te na kumbhimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na kaḷopimukhā paṭiggaṇhanti na eḷakam'antaraṃ na daṇḍam'antaraṃ na musalam'antaraṃ na dvinnaṃ bhuñjamānānaṃ na gabbhiniyā na pāyamānāya na puris'antaragatāya

5715.grammar: idiom, nt + abs, abs of antaraṃ karoti

examples.text: so kāmarāgaṃ'y'eva antaraṃ katvā jhāyati pajjhāyati nijjhāyati avajjhāyati.

5717.commentary: (MNa) cit'antar'aṃso'ti antar'aṃsaṃ vuccati dvinnaṃ koṭṭānam'antaraṃ, taṃ citaṃ paripuṇṇam'assā'ti cit'antar'aṃso. aññesañ'hi taṃ ṭhānaṃ ninnaṃ hoti, dve piṭṭhikoṭṭā pāṭiyekkaṃ paññāyanti. tathāgatassa pana kaṭito paṭṭhāya maṃsapaṭalaṃ yāva khandhā uggamma samussitasuvaṇṇaphalakaṃ viya piṭṭhiṃ chādetvā patiṭṭhitaṃ.

examples.text: cit'antar'aṃso kho pana so bhavaṃ gotamo, idam'pi tassa bhoto gotamassa mahāpurisassa mahāpurisalakkhaṇaṃ bhavati.

5718.grammar: ind, prep, abl sg of antara (+acc or +gen or +loc)
5718.commentary: (VINa) antarā satthīnaṃ karitvā'ti catunnaṃ pādānaṃ antare karitvā. (SNa) antarā ca rājagahaṃ antarā ca nāḷandan'ti rājagahassa ca nāḷandāya ca antare.

examples.text: evaṃ me sutaṃ, ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā antarā ca rājagahaṃ antarā ca nāḷandaṃ addhānamaggappaṭipanno hoti mahatā bhikkhusaṅghena saddhiṃ pañcamattehi bhikkhusatehi

atha kho, bhikkhave, tittiro ca makkaṭo ca hatthināgaṃ pucchiṃsu, tvaṃ, samma, kiṃ porāṇaṃ sarasī'ti? yadā'haṃ, sammā, poto homi, imaṃ nigrodhaṃ antarā satthīnaṃ karitvā atikkamāmi, aggaṅkurakaṃ me udaraṃ chupati. im'āhaṃ, sammā, porāṇaṃ sarāmī'ti.

5719.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of antara
5719.meaning1: meanwhile; in the meantime; before the time

examples.text: so kho ahaṃ, bhante, aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato.
ubbhatasmiṃ kathine'ti aṭṭhannaṃ mātikānaṃ aññatarāya mātikāya ubbhataṃ hoti, saṅghena vā antarā ubbhataṃ hoti.

5720.grammar: ind, adv, abl sg of antara (+acc or +gen or +loc)

examples.text: saññācikāya pana bhikkhunā kuṭiṃ kārayamānena assāmikaṃ att'uddesaṃ pamāṇikā kāretabbā, tatr'idaṃ pamāṇaṃ, dīghaso dvādasa vidatthiyo sugatavidatthiyā, tiriyaṃ satt'antarā

5721.synonym: kathā, kathāsallāpa, samudāhāra, sallāpa, sākaccha, sākacchā

examples.text: kāya nu'ttha, licchavī, eta'r'ahi kathāya sannisinnā, kā ca pana vo antarākathā vippakatā'ti

tena kho pana samayena sambahulānaṃ therānaṃ bhikkhūnaṃ pacchābhattaṃ piṇḍapātapaṭikkantānaṃ maṇḍalamāḷe sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi, vuttam'idaṃ, āvuso, bhagavatā pārāyane metteyyapañhe.

5722.meaning2: load on a carrying pole suspended between two persons

5723.meaning2: in the middle; as an interruption

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, gahapati, puriso yācitakaṃ bhogaṃ yācitvā yānaṃ vā poriseyyaṃ pavaramaṇikuṇḍalaṃ. so tehi yācitakehi bhogehi purakkhato parivuto antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyya.

seyyathā'pi, āvuso, kaṃsapāti ābhatā āpaṇā vā kammārakulā vā parisuddhā pariyodātā. tam'enaṃ sāmikā ahikuṇapaṃ vā kukkurakuṇapaṃ vā manussakuṇapaṃ vā racayitvā aññissā kaṃsapātiyā paṭikujjitvā antar'āpaṇaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ.

5725.commentary: (ANa) antarāparinibbāyī'ti yo āyuvemajjhaṃ anatikkamitvā parinibbāyati, so tividho hoti. kappasahass'āyukesu tāva avihesu nibbattitvā eko nibbattadivasey'eva arahattaṃ pāpuṇāti. no ce nibbattadivase pāpuṇāti, paṭhamassa pana kappasatassa matthake pāpuṇāti, ayaṃ paṭhamo antarāparinibbāyī. aparo evaṃ asakkonto dvinnaṃ kappasatānaṃ matthake pāpuṇāti, ayaṃ dutiyo. aparo evam'pi asakkonto catunnaṃ kappasatānaṃ matthake pāpuṇāti, ayaṃ tatiyo antarāparinibbāyī.

examples.text: no ce diṭṭh'eva dhamme paṭikacca aññaṃ ārādheti, no ce maraṇakāle aññaṃ ārādheti, atha pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti.
taṃ vā pana anabhisambhavaṃ appaṭivijjhaṃ pañcannaṃ oram'bhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ parikkhayā antarāparinibbāyī hoti.

5726.meaning2: offence committed in the meantime (i.e. before the expiration of a parivāsa or mānatta period)

5727.meaning1: intermediate state of existence; intermediary life

5728.grammar: ind, adv, comp, abl of antarāmagga

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, bhikkhave, rājā kāle senaṃ uyyojetvā antarāmaggato nivattāpeti. yesaṃ taṃ amanāpaṃ tesaṃ evaṃ hoti, rājā kho pabbajitena saṃsaṭṭho.

5729.grammar: ind, adv, comp, loc sg of antarāmagga
5729.meaning1: along the road; on the way
5729.meaning2: on the way, on the road

examples.text: so ñātakehi nīyamāno appatvā'va ñātake antarāmagge kālaṃ karoti. evarūpo'pi, bhikkhave, idh'ekacco yodh'ājīvo hoti. ayaṃ, bhikkhave, dutiyo yodh'ājīvo santo saṃvijjamāno lokasmiṃ.
satthena vā visena vā, vihesam'pi na kubbate, antarāmaraṇaṃ n'atthi, tesaṃ nissandato mama.

5732.meaning2: released or vacant in the meantime

examples.text: idha vassaṃ vasissāmi, idha hem'antagimhisu, iti bālo vicinteti, antarāyaṃ na bujjhati.
pāṭaliputtassa kho, ānanda, tayo antarāyā bhavissanti, aggito vā udakato vā mithubhedā vā'ti.

5734.meaning1: who creates obstacles; who makes problems (for); who obstructs
5734.commentary: (DNa) antarāyakaro'ti lābh'antarāyakaro. (DNa) tesaṃ antarāyakaro'ti tesaṃ maggasampatti-phalasampatti-dibbabhava-visesānaṃ antarāyakaro. (SNa) antarāyakarā'ti dāyakassa sagg'antarāyo, paṭiggāhakānaṃ lābh'antarāyo, attano upaghāto'ti imesaṃ antarāyānaṃ kārakā. (ANa) antarāyakaro hotī'ti antarāyaṃ vināsaṃ kicchalābhakaṃ vilomakaṃ karoti.

examples.text: ye'dha maccharino loke, kadariyā paribhāsakā, aññesaṃ dadamānānaṃ, antarāyakarā narā.
yā sālavatikāya samudayasañjāti lohicco'va taṃ brāhmaṇo ekako paribhuñjeyya, na aññesaṃ dadeyyā'ti. evaṃ vādī so ye taṃ upajīvanti, tesaṃ antarāyakaro vā hoti, no vā'ti?

5735.commentary: (ANa) antarāyakaro hotī'ti antarāyaṃ vināsaṃ kicchalābhakaṃ vilomakaṃ karoti.

examples.text: yo kho, vaccha, paraṃ dānaṃ dadantaṃ vāreti so tiṇṇaṃ antarāyakaro hoti, tiṇṇaṃ pāripanthiko. katamesaṃ tiṇṇaṃ?

5736.commentary: (MNa) antarāyam'akāsī'ti yathā pabbajjaṃ na labhati, evaṃ upaddutam'akāsi yathā taṃ upanissayavipannaṃ.

examples.text: mā bhavaṃ, udāyi, samaṇe gotame brahmacariyaṃ cari, mā bhavaṃ, udāyi, ācariyo hutvā antevāsīvāsaṃ vasī'ti. iti h'idaṃ sakul'udāyissa paribbājakassa parisā sakul'udāyiṃ paribbājakaṃ antarāyam'akāsi bhagavati brahmacariye'ti.
dāruṇo, bhikkhave, lābhasakkārasiloko kaṭuko pharuso antarāyiko anuttarassa yogakkhemassa adhigamāya.
tath'āhaṃ bhagavatā dhammaṃ desitaṃ ājānāmi yathā ye'me antarāyikā dhammā vuttā bhagavatā te paṭisevato n'ālaṃ antarāyāyā'ti.

5740.meaning1: yet along the way; but meanwhile
5740.meaning2: yet along the way; but meanwhile
5740.commentary: (ANa) antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato'ti cakkavāḷalokassa antaṃ appatvā antarā'va mato. so pana tattha kālaṃ katvā'pi āgantvā imasmiṃ'y'eva cakkavāḷe nibbatti.

examples.text: aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'y'eva kālaṅ'kato.

5741.meaning1: inside the monastery; (comm) monastery inside the village

examples.text: anāpatti samaye, santaṃ bhikkhuṃ āpucchā pavisati, asantaṃ bhikkhuṃ anāpucchā pavisati, aññassa gharena maggo hoti, ghar'ūpacārena maggo hoti, antar'ārāmaṃ gacchati, bhikkhun'upassayaṃ gacchati

so khv'āhaṃ, bhante, evarūpena javena samannāgato evarūpena ca padavītihārena aññatr'eva asitapītakhāyitasāyitā aññatra uccārapassāvakammā aññatra niddākilamathapaṭivinodanā vassasat'āyuko vassasatajīvī vassasataṃ gantvā appatvā'va lokassa antaṃ antarā'va kālaṅ'kato.

5744.meaning1: stopping half way; finishing half the job
5744.meaning2: ceasing on half-way; stop in between

examples.text: na oramattakena vises'ādhigamena antarāvosānaṃ āpajjissanti
esā antaradhāyāmi, kucchiṃ vā pavisāmi te, pakhum'antarikāyam'pi, tiṭṭhantiṃ maṃ na dakkhasi.
atthi, bhikkhave, lok'antarikā aghā asaṃvutā andhakārā andhakāratimisā, yattham'imesaṃ candimasūriyānaṃ evaṃmah'iddhikānaṃ evaṃ mah'ānubhāvānaṃ ābhāya n'ānubhontī'ti.

5748.meaning2: removal (of the Kaṭhina), ending (of the Kaṭhina period and its special allowances) before the usual time

5749.grammar: ind, adv, loc sg of antara (+gen or +loc)

examples.text: etasmiṃ yaṃ vijjati antare dhanaṃ, muttā maṇi veḷuriyañ'ca bhaddakaṃ, siṅgīsuvaṇṇaṃ atha vā'pi kañcanaṃ, yaṃ jātarūpaṃ haṭakan'ti vuccati.
dvinnaṃ pana nagarānaṃ antare ubhayanagaravāsīnam'pi lumbinīvanaṃ nāma maṅgalasālavanaṃ atthi, tasmiṃ samaye mūlato paṭṭhāya yāva aggasākhā sabbaṃ ekapāliphullaṃ ahosi

5750.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of antara (+gen)

examples.text: tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tena tato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha. yato tvaṃ bāhiya na tattha tato tvaṃ bāhiya n'ev'idha na huraṃ na ubhayam'antarena.
tam'enaṃ evaṃ vadeyya, ayaṃ te, ambho purisa, samatittiko telapatto antarena ca mahāsamajjaṃ antarena ca janapadakalyāṇiyā pariharitabbo.
na antalikkhe na samuddamajjhe, na pabbatānaṃ vivaraṃ pavissa, na vijjati so jagatippadeso, yatthaṭṭhito mucceyya pāpakammā.
yadā have pātubhavanti dhammā, ātāpino jhāyato brāhmaṇassa, vidhūpayaṃ tiṭṭhati mārasenaṃ, sūriyo'va obhāsayam'antalikkhan'ti.

5752.meaning1: related to sky; atmospheric; heavenly; celestial

examples.text: yathā vā pana, mahārāja, brāhmaṇamāṇavakānaṃ… bhūmikampaṃ disādāhaṃ bhumm'antalikkhaṃ jotisaṃ lok'āyatikaṃ sācakkaṃ migacakkaṃ antaracakkaṃ missak'uppādaṃ sakuṇarutaravitaṃ sikkhā karaṇīyā

5753.meaning1: moving through the sky; travelling by air

examples.text: cando ca sūriyo ca ubho sudassanā, obhāsayaṃ anupariyanti yāvatā, tamonudā te pana antalikkhagā, nabhe pabhāsanti disāvirocanā.

5754.meaning1: moving through the sky; travelling through the air

examples.text: saṃvaṭṭamāne loke yebhuyyena sattā ābhassarasaṃvattanikā honti. te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhacarā subhaṭṭhāyino, ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.

5755.grammar: ind, adv, comp vb, loc sg of antalikkha
5755.meaning1: in the sky; in the air
5755.construction:
antara > antari > antali + kha + e
antalikkha + e

examples.text: yān'īdha bhūtāni samāgatāni, bhummāni vā yāni va antalikkhe, sabb'eva bhūtā sumanā bhavantu, atho'pi sakkacca suṇantu bhāsitaṃ.
na antalikkhe na samuddamajjhe, na pabbatānaṃ vivaraṃ pavissa, na vijjatī so jagatippadeso, yatthaṭṭhitaṃ nappasaheyya maccu.

5756.meaning1: moving through the sky; travelling through the air

examples.text: te tattha honti manomayā pītibhakkhā sayaṃpabhā antalikkhecarā subhaṭṭhāyino ciraṃ dīgham'addhānaṃ tiṭṭhanti.

5758.meaning1: (gram) elision of the final letter of a word

examples.text: disaiccetāya dhātuyā tun'ādīnaṃ paccayānaṃ svānasvādesā honti, antalopo ca.

5759.meaning1: perceiving as finite; regarding as limited
5759.commentary: (DNa) antasaññī lokasmiṃ viharatī'ti paṭibhāganimittaṃ cakkavāḷapariyantaṃ avaḍḍhetvā taṃ, loko'ti gahetvā antasaññī lokasmiṃ viharati, cakkavāḷapariyantaṃ katvā vaḍḍhitakasiṇo pana anantasaññī hoti, uddham'adho avaḍḍhetvā pana tiriyaṃ vaḍḍhetvā uddham'adho antasaññī, tiriyaṃ anantasaññī. takkīvādo vuttanayen'eva veditabbo. ime cattāro'pi attanā diṭṭhapubb'ānusāren'eva diṭṭhiyā gahitattā pubb'antakappikesu paviṭṭhā.

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco samaṇo vā brāhmaṇo vā ātappam'anvāya padhānam'anvāya anuyogam'anvāya appamādam'anvāya sammāmanasikāram'anvāya tathārūpaṃ cetosamādhiṃ phusati, yathāsamāhite citte antasaññī lokasmiṃ viharati.

5761.meaning2: Chapter 11 of the Khandhasaṃyuttaṃ, Book 3 of the Saṃyutta Nikāya

examples.text: kiṃ pana, bhante, antavā loko, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti? etam'pi kho, poṭṭhapāda, mayā abyākataṃ, antavā loko, idam'eva saccaṃ mogham'aññan'ti.

5768.meaning1: makes an end (of); finishes (with); puts (something) to rest

examples.text: puccha vāsava maṃ pañhaṃ, yaṃ kiñci manas'icchasi, tassa tass'eva pañhassa, ahaṃ antaṃ karomi te'ti.

5769.meaning2: finite or infinite; limited or endless

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ant'ānantikā ant'ānantaṃ lokassa paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi.

5770.meaning1: doctrine of the finite and the infinite

5771.meaning2: who holds a view of finiteness or infiniteness
5771.commentary: (DNa) ant'ānantikā'ti ant'ānantavādā, antaṃ vā anantaṃ vā ant'ānantaṃ vā n'ev'ant'ānānantaṃ vā ārabbha pavattavādā'ti attho.

examples.text: santi, bhikkhave, eke samaṇabrāhmaṇā ant'ānantikā ant'ānantaṃ lokassa paññapenti catūhi vatthūhi.

5772.meaning2: illness of twisting of the gut

5773.meaning1: (gram) verbal ending of the present tense 3rd person plural

examples.text: taṃ yathā? ti anti iti paṭhamapurisā, si tha iti majjhimapurisā, mi ma iti uttamapurisā. attanopadānampi te ante iti paṭhamapurisā, se vhe iti majjhimapurisā, e mhe iti uttamapurisā. evaṃ sabbattha.
atha kho bhagavato vass'ūpagatassa kharo ābādho uppajji, bāḷhā vedanā vattanti māraṇ'antikā.

5775.meaning1: ending with; limited to; concluding with
5775.commentary: (THIa) etadantikā'ti etaṃ idāni mayā adhigataṃ arahattaṃ anto pariyosānaṃ etesan'ti etadantikā, sokā. na dāni tesaṃ sambhavo atthī'ti attho.

examples.text: sabbe sokā samucchinnā, pahīnā etadantikā, pariññātā hi me vatthū, yato sokāna sambhavo'ti.
ñāṇañ'ca pana me dassanaṃ udapādi. akuppā me vimutti, ayam'antimā jāti, n'atthi dāni punabbhavo'ti
aham'asmi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko sallakatto.

5778.meaning1: carrying the last body; in one's final existence

examples.text: aham'asmi, bhikkhave, brāhmaṇo yācayogo sadā payatapāṇi antimadehadharo anuttaro bhisakko sallakatto.

5779.meaning1: carrying the last body; in one's final existence
5779.commentary: (ITIa) āyatiṃ punabbhav'ābhāvato antimaṃ, pacchimaṃ dehaṃ kāyaṃ dhāretī'ti antimadehadhārī

examples.text: yo hoti bhikkhu arahaṃ katāvī, khīṇ'āsavo antimadehadhārī, ahaṃ vadāmī'ti'pi so vadeyya, mamaṃ vadantī'ti'pi so vadeyyā'ti.
tamonudaṃ pāragataṃ mah'esiṃ, taṃ pattipattaṃ vasimaṃ anāsavaṃ, visan'taraṃ taṇhakkhaye vimuttaṃ, taṃ ve muniṃ antimadehadhāriṃ, mārañ'jahaṃ brūmi jarāya pāraguṃ.

5780.meaning1: carrying one's final body; in one's final corporeal existence

examples.text: tīhi vijjāhi sampannaṃ, asammūḷhavihārinaṃ, buddhaṃ antimadehinaṃ, taṃ namassanti gotamaṃ.

5781.meaning1: final person; last of the lineage; last man standing
5781.meaning2: last man, meanest man; last of the line

examples.text: yena me idaṃ kalyāṇaṃ vattaṃ nihitaṃ anuppavatteyyāsi, mā kho me tvaṃ antimapuriso ahosi. yasmiṃ kho, tāta kumāra, purisayuge vattamāne evarūpassa kalyāṇassa vattassa samucchedo hoti so tesaṃ antimapuriso hoti.
vītataṇho anādāno, niruttipadakovido, akkharānaṃ sannipātaṃ, jaññā pubb'āparāni ca, sa ve antimasārīro mahāpañño, mahāpuriso'ti vuccati.
akkodhanaṃ vatavantaṃ, sīlavantaṃ anussadaṃ, dantaṃ antimasārīraṃ, tam'ahaṃ brūmi brāhmaṇaṃ.
niṭṭhaṅ'gato asantāsī, vītataṇho anaṅgaṇo, acchindi bhavasallāni, antimo'yaṃ samussayo.
seyyathā'pi bhikkhave dakkho bhamakāro vā bhamakār'antevāsī vā dīghaṃ vā añchanto dīghaṃ añchāmī'ti pajānāti rassaṃ vā añchanto rassaṃ añchāmī'ti pajānāti
tena kho pana samayena rañño utenassa uyyānagatassa antepuraṃ daḍḍhaṃ hoti, pañca ca itthisatāni kālaṅ'katāni honti sāmāvatīpamukhāni.

5786.grammar: ind, adv, instr sg of anta
5786.meaning1: at the end; in the end; at death

examples.text: atha antena jahati, sarīraṃ sapariggahaṃ, etadaññāya medhāvī, bhuñjetha ca dadetha ca, datvā ca bhutvā ca yath'ānubhāvaṃ, anindito saggam'upeti ṭhānan'ti.
tena kho pana samayena rañño utenassa uyyānagatassa antepuraṃ daḍḍhaṃ hoti, pañca ca itthisatāni kālaṅ'katāni honti sāmāvatīpamukhāni.
tena kho pana samayena rāj'antepure rājaparisāya sannisinnānaṃ sannipatitānaṃ ayam'antarākathā udapādi
alaṃ, bhaṇe jīvaka, tuyham'eva hotu. amhākaññ'eva antepure nivesanaṃ māpehī'ti.

5789.meaning1: door of the inner palace; gate of the inner citadel

examples.text: atha kho, āvuso, rājā pasenadi kosalo sāvatthiyā nikkhamitvā antepuradvārā paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya, paṭhamena rathavinītena dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya, paṭhamaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya dutiyaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya.
chaṭṭhena rathavinītena sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ pāpuṇeyya, chaṭṭhaṃ rathavinītaṃ vissajjeyya, sattamaṃ rathavinītaṃ abhiruheyya. sattamena rathavinītena sāketaṃ anupāpuṇeyya antepuradvāraṃ.

5790.meaning1: who arrived at the door of the inner palace; come to the gate of the inner citadel

examples.text: tam'enaṃ antepuradvāragataṃ samānaṃ mitt'āmaccā ñātisālohitā evaṃ puccheyyuṃ, iminā tvaṃ, mahārāja, rathavinītena sāvatthiyā sāketaṃ anuppatto antepuradvāran'ti?

5791.meaning1: rule about the king's inner citadel; Pācittiya 83

5793.meaning2: who lives with his master, attendant, pupil

examples.text: tehi'pi saddhiṃ gacchantesu pañcasu paribbājakasatesu sañcayassa aḍḍhateyyasatāni nivattiṃsu, atha kho te attano antevāsikehi aḍḍhateyyehi paribbājakasatehi saddhiṃ veḷuvanaṃ agamaṃsu.

5794.meaning1: desire for students; wish to get pupils

examples.text: siyā kho pana te, nigrodha, evam'assa, antevāsikamyatā no samaṇo gotamo evam'āhā'ti. na kho pan'etaṃ, nigrodha, evaṃ daṭṭhabbaṃ. yo eva vo ācariyo, so eva vo ācariyo hotu.

5796.commentary: (VINa) buddhavevacanāni vā'ti buddhassa vā pariyāyanāmāni… asakyaputtiyassa vā. tattha vaṇṇapaṭṭhāne āgataṃ nāmasahassaṃ upāligāthāsu (ma ni 2.76) nāmasataṃ aññāni ca guṇato labbhamānāni nāmāni buddhavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. sabbāni'pi dhammassa nāmāni dhammavevacanānī'ti veditabbāni. esa nayo sabbattha.

examples.text: atha kho subhaddo paribbājako āyasmantaṃ ānandaṃ etadavoca, lābhā vo, āvuso ānanda, suladdhaṃ vo, āvuso ānanda, ye ettha satthu sammukhā antevāsik'ābhisekena abhisittāti.

5799.meaning2: 'dwelling near or in the house (of her master)', (who is) a (resident) pupil; apprentice
